sourceEvidence.title: Plant Manager
sourceEvidence.quote:
## Description
Depending on the position, on-call status may or may not apply. Some travel may be involved to participate in Manager, Owner, User Group, or other offsite meetings. **Compensation** This position offers an annual base salary ranging from $175,000 to $230,000 and includes eligibility for an annual performance bonus. **Leadership & Technical Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline preferred.
Equivalent power generation, industrial, or military experience may be considered in lieu of formal education.
* Extensive leadership experience in natural gas-fired combined cycle power generation, including experience leading multi-disciplinary plant organizations; prior Plant Manager experience preferred.
* Demonstrated success leading operations, maintenance, engineering, and technical personnel within a combined-cycle power plant.
